description: Runtime contract fixtures for the agnthive hook dispatcher (plan task 02; design F01-F10, ADR 0010-0013). One manifest entry per scenario; entries may share a payload when only the expected output class differs (the two PermissionDenied entries share one stdin).
cli_version_basis: The canaries in this manifest were captured on the pinned CLI 2.1.303 with the local ollama provider (see each entry's capture_method). 2.1.292 stays the review-time compatibility baseline and is NOT a version any payload here was captured on.

status_model.active: The contract test spawns the dispatcher with this payload today and asserts the event-specific output class in the expected_class vocabulary.
status_model.pending_capture: The payload is a placeholder of the documented input shape only; the runtime contract for this scenario is NOT pinned. The contract test validates the manifest entry and payload shape but skips dispatcher execution. A manual canary on the target CLI (a live, instrumented Claude Code session capturing hook stdin to a file) must replace the placeholder and set source=captured + status=active. When the host does not expose the scenario at all, the entry keeps capture_blocked_reason instead of a capture.
status_model.captured: The payload was observed on the target CLI in a live session: the file under payloads/ is the recorded hook stdin, redacted (ids/paths replaced by synthetic placeholders, free text truncated) with the field shape preserved. The entry is executed by the contract test like any other active entry.

The classification is TEXT driven — see compat_user_prompt_submit_other_classified for the other branch.

entries.description: PostCompact after a real compaction: bounded bookkeeping only (ADR 0013); async stdout JSON is not proven delivery to the model (F07), and compact_summary content must be redacted at capture.
entries.capture_instructions: Manual canary on target CLI: capture PostCompact stdin right after a real compaction; redact or truncate compact_summary before storing.
entries.capture_blocked_reason: The host DOES emit the PostCompact hook on 2.1.303 (debug log: "Registering async hook async_hook_NNNNNN (PostCompact:manual)" and "PostCompact:manual [...] completed with status 0"), but the async hook is CANCELLED at session end ("Hook PostCompact:manual (PostCompact) cancelled:") before its stdin payload can be read, so the payload could not be observed. The same log shows the plugin PostCompact output is never delivered to the model, which confirms the F07 claim (async stdout JSON is not a delivery channel). Re-capture needs a session that keeps running past the compaction (interactive or background session), which the headless canary cannot reach.

entries.description: A real agent dispatch. Captured live on 2.1.303: the host sends session_id, transcript_path, cwd, prompt_id, agent_id, agent_type and hook_event_name — the agent identity is agent_id + agent_type (no agent_alias field).
entries.capture_method: Live `claude -p` session on CLI 2.1.303 (local ollama provider, model glm-5.2:cloud). The plugin was loaded from an instrumented COPY in /tmp whose hook registration tees the raw hook stdin to a file; the plugin runtime modules were not modified. The payload is the observed stdin, redacted (ids and paths replaced by synthetic placeholders, free text truncated).
entries.capture_note: The agent_type value is host-assigned ("Explore" in this run, "agnthive:Explorer" in a run that used the plugin agent namespace) — it is not a plugin alias, so the runtime must not read it as an alias.

entries.description: Repeated SubagentStart for an already-known agent id (resume): lifecycle must update in place, not count a second specialist instance (F08, ADR 0010). The resume marker field is the unknown to capture.
entries.capture_instructions: Manual canary on target CLI: resume the same subagent twice in a live session and dump both SubagentStart stdin JSON payloads; compare the identity fields.
entries.capture_blocked_reason: On 2.1.303 the host does NOT re-emit SubagentStart when an agent is resumed: in the live canary a background agent produced SubagentStart once and then TWO SubagentStop events for the same agent_id, the second with stop_hook_active=true. The repeated-SubagentStart marker therefore does not exist on this host; the resume is observable only on SubagentStop. The real dispatch payload is stored in the new entry compat_subagent_start_dispatch.

entries.capture_note: The captured event is the RETRIABLE variant: the host denied the call through the auto-mode permission classifier, the agnthive policy does not hard-deny that command, and the runtime answered retry:true. The HARD-DENIED variant (retry:false) was NOT observed — with the plugin as shipped every policy-hard-denied command is blocked at PreToolUse before the permission stage, and the host only emits PermissionDenied for auto-mode classifier denials.
